commit.message:
Add DateTimePicker to the date family (2.5.0) (#41)

* Add DateTimePicker to the date family (2.5.0)

A date and a time of day in one native datetime-local field. Its popup
sets hour, minute and (on a twelve-hour clock) day-period columns beside
the shared Calendar. Each column is a Base RadioGroup in its own Base
Field, so Base owns roving focus, the arrow keys, disabled-skip and
keeping the checked reading in view. Values are civil YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm
readings with no time zone, exactly as the native input submits them.

A half-chosen value waits for its other half before committing, and a
choice that crosses min/max settles on the bound, so the popup cannot
produce a value the field would reject. The hour cycle follows the
locale, minuteStep defaults to 5, and Done is Base Popover.Close.

The native date fields of all three pickers now clip the browser's own
calendar glyph in right-to-left pages too: the clipping slot is fixed
left-to-right, because Chromium lays native dates out LTR regardless of
dir while Firefox mirrors them (and scrambles datetime-local under RTL).

Additive public component and types: minor bump 2.4.0 -> 2.5.0.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Verify a disabled DateTimePicker opened by its owner offers nothing

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Install CI browsers from the lockfile's Playwright

The workspace root has no `playwright` bin, so `bunx playwright install`
downloaded whatever npm called latest (now 1.64.0) and installed a
Chromium build the pinned 1.63.0 runner cannot find: every browser test
in the verify and browser-showcase jobs failed at launch. Install through
the showcase's pinned binary instead.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Never let the time panel commit a refused or invented value

From an independent review of DateTimePicker:
- a held day the constraints refuse (out of range, unavailable, or a day
  whose min is after its max) no longer anchors time edits, and nothing
  is committed unless the final value passes the field's own check;
- a minute or AM/PM chosen before an hour waits for its hour instead of
  committing an invented 12:45 AM, and a chosen period decides which
  hours the column lists (with nothing chosen, the first period the day
  accepts);
- a column whose reading changes from outside it remounts its Base
  RadioGroup, so its tab stop and scroll follow the reading.

Each case has a browser test, confirmed to fail on the previous code.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit.message:
Add the v2.1 component wave (#26)

* Define additive v2.1 component contracts on stable 2.x

* Add initial Stepper implementation and focused specimens

* Integrate Stepper and fix current-complete precedence

* Add initial Pagination and Breadcrumb implementation

* Integrate navigation specimens and await settled RTL geometry

* Add initial Calendar and date picker family

* Integrate date specimens and harden navigation boundaries

* Add initial Command and CommandPalette implementation

* Add initial TreeView implementation

* Add initial FileUpload implementation

* Integrate component wave and correct controlled interaction contracts

* Harden date validation and verify the complete component wave

* Preserve accessible wave states and stable interaction targets

* Refine component wave from cross-browser visual audit

* Align pagination, uploads, steps and date feedback with the design system

* Adapt navigation to container width and raise held selections

* Isolate acrylic surfaces and correct navigation wrapping
